hdl: HDL is a lipoprotein that transports cholesterol in the blood.
HDL means the same as high-density lipoprotein or alpha-lipoprotein.
hdl cholesterol: HDL cholesterol is the cholesterol in high-density lipoproteins.
hdtv: HDTV is a television system that has more than the usual number of lines per frame so its pictures show more detail.
HDTV means the same as high-definition television.
